title: Fiore master marks with inherited starting states and explicit nonadjacent ownership
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Getty around 1410 uses crowns/bands plus prose to bind scholar variants to a shared starting action. The complete 16v-d paragraph explicitly overrides placement after a counter. This is an attested contextual reference mechanism, not a target gloss or writer.

design.scope_limit: Source-attested contextual reference mechanism; no selected experiment, target reading, decoder, newly admitted Voynich evidence or publication.
design.structural_baseline: Directed composition, spaces, whole-form residuals and entry effects are structural findings, not a known segmentation into meanings. These sources do not supply a target alphabet or justify one word per source instruction.
design.access: Public historical sources and existing claim-bearing reports only. No new Voynich source/image, reserve, mixed raw TSV or GDT988 file access.
selection_debts: Nominate an entire admitted target passage before fitting, preserve every group and declare whether the hypothesis covers prose, content or a multimodal reference system.
Specify a finite shared surface writer and argument-binding rules before a target test; no per-word key, invisible content or convenient local exception.
A source mechanism can support exploration without an independently confirmed seedword, but it does not establish a Voynich meaning.
retained_stops: GDT947 overt-core olshedy/olshey reference duties remain contradicted under their fixed scope; no inherited ol or q gloss.
GDT901 fixed complete solmization-register models remain excluded; this task makes no new music card.
GDT986/987 and GDT988 have no proposed repair here. These source mechanisms were acquired independently of their target results.

source_evidence.quote: ## A. Fiore: marks identify roles, while prose binds the inherited procedure

source.author: Fiore dei Liberi
source.date: around 1410 according to Getty catalogue; not the dated 1409 Pisani Dossi witness
source.inspection: All three original pages viewed natively; Italian transcriptions collated for navigation, with abbreviations expanded. No modern English translation is used as source code.
source.complete_short_content: The explanatory master/scholar/remedy/counter block on 2r is inventoried, its shared-start paragraph quoted in full, and the full 16v-d placement-correction paragraph quoted. The 6v inventory describes connected reference dependencies rather than claiming a full verbatim translation.

observed_notation.crown: Initial guard master or remedy master; context distinguishes those roles.
observed_notation.band_below_knee: Scholar inheriting a remedy master's stated starting cover or hold.
observed_notation.crown_and_band: Counter master in the explanatory scheme; not a unique physical person.
observed_notation.named_reference: 16v-d explicitly assigns its scholar to the sixth master despite being placed after the counter.
observed_notation.scope: Written rubrics, figure marks and prose jointly carry the reference. No universal linear adjacency-only rule is source-licensed.

provisional_semantic_contract.binding: A variant inherits the named master's starting action; a new start must be explicitly supplied. An express named owner can override normal displayed scope. Arbitrary occurrence-specific overrides are forbidden.
provisional_semantic_contract.limits: Modern typed representation of the source relationships, not an attested serializer or a complete target grammar. The source permits a fourth counter-counter master in some places; the bounded contract does not silently infer unbounded nesting.

claims: The remedy and its following scholars share a starting cover or hold.
The normal family ends when the counter master appears.
coupled_content.joint_consequence: A scholar is constrained by a particular family and starting condition, not only by a generic student label.

claims: The second play identifies its master and an opponent-dependent alternative.
The third play expressly confirms and continues that conditional transition.
coupled_content.joint_consequence: The two references must bind the same role and stated condition; unconstrained fresh initial states or an unordered bag of play names loses the content.

claims: The scholar is physically placed after the counter.
Its own full paragraph says it logically belongs before that counter and to the sixth master.
coupled_content.joint_consequence: The intended parent is not always the closest preceding marked master. Source-written correction, not analyst repair, resolves this instance.

distinct_rivals.rule: Each mark has one context-free discourse role.
distinct_rivals.failure: The crown alone cannot distinguish initial guard master from remedy master.

distinct_rivals.rule: Every scholar belongs to the immediately preceding marked master.
Each scholar has an independently chosen starting hold.
distinct_rivals.failure: Drops the common-start assertion on 2r and connected inheritance on 6v.

symmetries_and_risks: Consistent renaming of master identities can preserve the relation graph; it does not recover physical people or words.
The marks are visible illustrations, not evidence that textual components share their semantic inventory.
The 6v fourth-play paragraph calls later alternatives outside the bounded extract; those unresolved calls are not invented successful continuations.
No historical statement that these techniques work is treated as experimental biomechanical evidence.
Without explicit named ownership or a finitely bounded realization, this could collapse into a freely fitted reference graph.
